_comment: Contratos de arte do Empire que a Forja aplica. Cada numero vem de um documento citado em 'source'; test_contracts.py confere-os contra as tabelas da Asset Bible e da Animation Bible, para nao divergirem em silencio. Estado de cada contrato em 'status': uma proposta da Asset Bible nao e uma decisao fechada.

character_s1.en: small side-view game character (scale 1: squire, small troops)
character_s1.label: Personagem escala 1 (escudeiro, tropas pequenas, Rastejante)
character_s1.status: proposta da Asset Bible (telas padrao a validar)

tags._source: docs/art/ANIMATION_BIBLE.md §2 — idle/walk/attack/die marcados (§) sao do dossie; o resto e proposta da bible

idle.note: feet planted; breathing; 0.6 s cycle is the project's metronome

walk.note: in place; contact poses on frames 1 and 5; step about 10 px

attack.note: anticipation 1-2, hit on frame 3, recovery 4-5, feet planted

die.note: fall on frame 3; the last frame is the body left on the ground and must read as revivable

run.note: in place; contact on frames 1 and 4

carry.note: walk cycle carrying something; contact on 1 and 5

celebrate.note: short loop, 2 px jump on frame 3

ride.note: rider and mount in the same body

climb.note: vertical motion comes from the simulation

spawn.note: creature rises out of the Rot stain
